technique: Normalize aggregate targets using observed fine-grained history
problem_addressed: Very short daily history with hourly observations available
when_to_use: Daily/weekly forecasting with available hourly history
All scale statistics can be fit before prediction cutoff
mechanism: Hourly extrema can define an aggregate target range when daily range has too few points.
failure_modes: Hourly extrema do not represent future seasonal range
Near-zero range and eps behavior dominate
evidence_level: observed implementation + author rationale; no reproduced gain
recommended_tests: Compare by history length and horizon on group/time holdout
compute_tradeoffs: Scale computation cheap relative to model training; full runtime unknown.

problem_addressed: Final artifact differs from model-family description
when_to_use: Multiple scripts/components produce a final submission
mechanism: An override changes predictions after ordinary averaging, so it must be traced as a separate stage.
failure_modes: Missing component rows silently change effective weights
Binary labels drift from updated probabilities
evidence_level: verified code observations across two competitions; benefits not established
recommended_tests: Base blend vs override on untouched holdout
Assert exact ID set and final probability/label consistency
compute_tradeoffs: Postprocessing cheap; error review and inference assets may not be.

technique: Match validation aggregation and independence to the evaluation target
problem_addressed: Pooled performance hides geographically small groups and repeated locations
mechanism: Regional aggregation gives each region equal top-level contribution; geographic holdout tests location generalization.
failure_modes: UID grouping mistaken for independent lake grouping
Pooled model selection optimizes a different objective
Too few geographic groups yields high fold variance
evidence_level: official metric + inspected split code; no causal gain reproduced
recommended_tests: Report each regional RMSE and macro score
compute_tradeoffs: Extra CV folds increase training; external imagery preparation can dominate.

technique: Audit implicit ensemble weights from repeated scene rows
problem_addressed: Mean over records weights modalities by number of available scenes
when_to_use: Multiple scenes per sample and satellite family
Predictions are concatenated then grouped by sample
mechanism: A record-level mean assigns more mass to a family that contributes more scene rows.
failure_modes: Validation scene counts differ from production
Rounding before vs after aggregation changes outputs
evidence_level: code behavior; equal-family alternative is untested
recommended_tests: Hold predictions fixed and compare record-weighted/equal-family means
Analyze score by scene coverage before choosing rule
compute_tradeoffs: Can compare cached predictions without retraining.

technique: Separate decision voting from probability ranking
problem_addressed: AUC and accuracy use different output columns
when_to_use: Submission or product needs both score and binary decision
mechanism: Majority class and max/min probability can reorder samples compared with mean probability.
failure_modes: Hardcoded vote cutoff with missing models
evidence_level: official metric + code observation + hypothesis; no controlled gain
recommended_tests: Verify model count and align all inputs by ID
compute_tradeoffs: Cached CSV comparison cheap; generating27models expensive and unmeasured.
